other.global_help:
📖 *Nexa User Guide*

Here is a list of commands you can use to maximize your experience with Nexa.

📝 *Basic Commands*
`/register` — Register your profile for the first time to access all Nexa features.
`/menu` — Display a complete list of all available menus, interactive features, and categories.
`/help` — Open this help center page to guide your usage.
`/ping` — Check response speed and ensure Nexa is online.
`/status` — View detailed information regarding server status, systems, and Nexa statistics.

💡 *Advanced Usage*
To get more detailed instructions on how a specific command works, you can use the following format:
`/help <command_name>`
Usage example: `/help play`

🛠️ *Help and Support Center*
`/report <bug_detail>` — Report errors, issues, or bugs you find directly to the owner.
`/donate` — Show appreciation and support for the Nexa project development via donation.
`/about` — Display information about the background, release version, and creators of the Nexa Project.
